name: J-Star Holding Co. Ltd.
summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd., established in 1968 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, is a global manufacturer and distributor specializing in bicycles, various sports accessories, and advanced carbon fiber composite products. The company's offerings in the cycling sector include essential components for both high-performance sports bicycles and electric models. Within sports equipment, J-Star produces a diverse array of paddle rackets, catering to disciplines such as tennis, badminton, squash, and beach tennis. Furthermore, their expertise in carbon fiber composites is applied to create structural parts for the automotive industry, a range of other sporting goods, and various healthcare products.
